$comment: Pin for the real-world WIT the parser is checked against. Read by BOTH
flake.nix (fetchzip, for Nix checkouts) and dev/fetch-wit-corpus.js (for
checkouts without Nix), so the URL never drifts between the two.
Pinned to a commit, not a branch: `refs/heads/main` is a moving target.
Two hashes because the two fetchers verify different things:
nixHash        - hash of the UNPACKED tree, what fetchzip wants.
then: nix hash convert --hash-algo sha256 --to sri <hash>
contentDigest  - sha256 over the extracted .wit files (sorted
'relpath sha256(bytes)' lines). Deliberately NOT a hash
of the tarball bytes: GitHub regenerates archives and
the gzip framing changes even when the content does not.
